create_litellm_client: create a LiteLLM proxy client with base_url and optional api_key for proxy API access
create_chat_completion: create a chat completion using the LiteLLM proxy chat client with model and messages
list_models: list all models supported by the LiteLLM proxy server
generate_api_key: generate a new API key with models, aliases, duration and budget constraints
create_credential: create a new credential with name, info and values on the LiteLLM proxy
create_model: add a new model to the LiteLLM proxy with name, params and optional model info
list_teams: list teams that the user belongs to with optional user and organization filters
make_http_request: make a generic HTTP request to the LiteLLM proxy server with method, uri and body
